## CheckConfiguration

```typescript
type CheckConfiguration =
  | {
      kind: "command";
      executable: string;
      args: string[];
      cwdRelativePath: string;
      checkerBundleMaterialId: string;
      entrypoint: string;
      fixtureMaterialIds: string[];
      environment: Record<string, string>;
      secretBindings: SecretBinding[];
      expectedExitCodes: number[];
      resultFormat: "foundry-check/v1";
      minimumAssertions: number;
    }
  | {
      /**
       * A command the project already owns, run by Foundry on the sealed
       * candidate. The exit code decides the verdict and the captured output
       * becomes the evidence, so no checker bundle or assertion format exists.
       */
      kind: "project_command";
      executable: string;
      args: string[];
      cwdRelativePath: string;
      environment: Record<string, string>;
      expectedExitCodes: number[];
    }
  | {
      kind: "http";
      targetName: string;
      method: string;
      path: string;
      headers: Record<string, string>;
      secretBindings: SecretBinding[];
      bodyMaterialId?: string;
      expectedStatus: number;
      expectedHeaders: Record<string, string>;
      expectedJsonValues: Record<string, JSONValue>;
    };
```

| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- |
| `schemaVersion`       | `1`                                           | 是   |
| `id`                  | `string`                                      | 是   |
| `workspaceId`         | `string`                                      | 是   |
| `issueId`             | `string`                                      | 是   |
| `createdAt`           | `DateTime`                                    | 是   |
| `createdBy`           | `ActorRef`                                    | 是   |
| `reviewSnapshotId`    | `string`                                      | 是   |
| `reviewDigest`        | `Digest`                                      | 是   |
| `contractRevision`    | `number`                                      | 是   |
| `candidateSnapshotId` | `string`                                      | 是   |
| `rationale`           | `RichContent`                                 | 否   |
| `status`              | `"approved" \| "invalidated" \| "integrated"` | 是   |
| `invalidatedAt`       | `DateTime`                                    | 否   |
| `invalidationReason`  | `string`                                      | 否   |
| `integrationId`       | `string`                                      | 否   |

## AuditEvent

| 字段            | 类型                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | 必填 |
| --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---- |
| `schemaVersion` | `1`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | 是   |
| `id`            | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 是   |
| `workspaceId`   | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 是   |
| `issueId`       | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 是   |
| `createdAt`     | `DateTime`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 是   |
| `createdBy`     | `ActorRef`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | 是   |
| `sequence`      | `number`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 是   |
| `action`        | `\| "contract_proposed" \| "contract_confirmed" \| "contract_discarded" \| "evidence_registered" \| "verification_requested" \| "verification_completed" \| "verification_failed" \| "human_assessed" \| "acceptance_approved" \| "acceptance_invalidated" \| "integration_started" \| "integration_completed" \| "integration_failed" \| "material_availability_changed" \| "candidate_sealed"` | 是   |
| `subject`       | `{ type: string; id: string }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | 是   |
| `beforeDigest`  | `Digest`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 否   |
| `afterDigest`   | `Digest`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 否   |
| `reason`        | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 否   |
| `requestId`     | `string`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 是   |

## VerificationSummary

| 字段            | 类型      | 必填 |
| --------------- | --------- | ---- |
| `requiredTotal` | `number`  | 是   |
| `passed`        | `number`  | 是   |
| `failed`        | `number`  | 是   |
| `inconclusive`  | `number`  | 是   |
| `pending`       | `number`  | 是   |
| `stale`         | `number`  | 是   |
| `eligible`      | `boolean` | 是   |

## ContractDraftInput

| 字段           | 类型              | 必填 |
| -------------- | ----------------- | ---- |
| `baseRevision` | `number`          | 否   |
| `content`      | `ContractContent` | 是   |
| `changeReason` | `string`          | 否   |

## CheckAssertion

| 字段       | 类型        | 必填 |
| ---------- | ----------- | ---- |
| `id`       | `string`    | 是   |
| `expected` | `JSONValue` | 是   |
| `observed` | `JSONValue` | 是   |
| `verdict`  | `Verdict`   | 是   |

| 字段         | 类型               | 必填 |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ---- |
| `assertions` | `CheckAssertion[]` | 是   |
